name: C.I.D Praha s.r.o.
summary: Czech arms supplier and SME based in Prague. It wins weapons contracts from the Czech Ministry of the Interior (Police of the Czech Republic) and the Ministry of Defence. Its main business on TED is 4.6×30 mm personal defence weapons (PDW submachine guns), supplied under framework agreements with spare parts and accessories. It also supplies spare parts and components for police long-gun systems. All its TED awards are in CPV 35300000.

offering.about: C.I.D Praha s.r.o. is a Prague-based firearms dealer that has operated on the Czech market since 1996, providing retail and wholesale sales of firearms, ammunition and accessories as well as trade in military material. It runs a physical shop in central Prague, has a wholesale division and offers discounts to members of the armed forces. It is the exclusive Czech civilian-market representative for several foreign manufacturers including Heckler & Koch, Sako, Fabarm, Hatsan, EOTECH and Sauvestre/Thifan.

product_portfolio.details: Brands stocked include Heckler & Koch, Sako, Fabarm, Hatsan, Glock, Sig Sauer, Daniel Defense, Springfield Armory, Kimber, B&T and Anderson Manufacturing.
Exclusive Czech representative for the French ammunition maker Sauvestre/Thifan Industrie.
Exclusive Czech representative for EOTECH; Trijicon also stocked.

certifications: Czech weapons licence (koncese) CG000458 (as stated on company website)
markets: Czech Republic - civilian retail and wholesale
Czech armed forces and security services (discounts for armed forces; military material trade)
offering.notes: Website lists exclusive representation of Heckler & Koch for the Czech civilian market; the 4.6x30 PDW supplied to Czech police per TED is very likely the HK MP7, but no source explicitly confirms C.I.D Praha as the MP7 supplier. About-us and wholesale pages returned no content/404, so no certifications beyond the weapons licence were found. Registered address seen in manuals: Gorazdova 1994/9, Praha 2.

proven: Weapons materiel and spare parts under 72-month frameworks with the Czech Ministry of the Interior (Police): 4.6×30 mm submachine guns, 9×19 mm submachine guns, HK G36 and HK416/417-class 5.56/7.62 mm rifles, .308 Win/.338 LM sniper rifles, 40×46 mm launchers
4.6×30 mm PDW submachine guns with spare parts and accessories (framework up to 120 months), plus call-offs from the Czech Ministry of Defence
Delivery record: 44 lots since May 2024, almost all through framework call-offs where it was the only bidder

summary: Rheinmetall's large weapons and ammunition company (Rheinmetall Waffe Munition, Unterlüß, Germany) and a main ammunition supplier to the Bundeswehr procurement office (BAAINBw). Its TED awards cover medium-calibre ammunition (30×173 mm DM58 practice rounds for IFVs, 40×53 mm HE and shaped-charge belted grenades), flash-bang hand grenades with training systems, and launcher equipment. It also exports to Nordic police forces, including a NOK 250M framework for 40×46 mm low-velocity CS and penetrating rounds for the Norwegian police.

The Danish Ministry of Defence Acquisition and Logistics Organisation (FMI) has entered into a contract with Rheinmetall Waffe Munition GmbH for the procurement of a new Decoy Launching System for the Royal Danish Navy. Specifically, FMI has entered into a contract for the procurement of five systems for the frigates of the ABSL and IVER classes. As part of the procurement, the supplier provides training as a service. 

FMI has furthermore entered into a framework agreement for the resupply of ammunition as well as a maintenance agreement with the supplier with a duration of up to 20 years. The maintenance contract includes the following services:
- Maintenance
- Support
- Spare parts
- Training

offering.about: Rheinmetall Waffe Munition GmbH (RWM), headquartered in Unterlüß, Germany, is Rheinmetall's weapons and ammunition subsidiary and describes itself as a leading supplier of weapon systems and ammunition for infantry, direct and indirect fire, pyrotechnics and protection systems. It was formed in 2004 from five predecessor companies including Mauser-Werke Oberndorf and BUCK Neue Technologien. It makes the main gun of the Leopard 2, artillery and medium-calibre ammunition, 40mm ammunition and pyrotechnic grenades for the Bundeswehr and other NATO forces.

product_portfolio.details: 155mm shells produced at the new Unterlüß plant; target of about 140,000 rounds in 2026 and up to 350,000 rounds/year from 2027.
30mm ammunition for the Puma IFV under a Bundeswehr framework contract (Dec 2022, extended to about EUR 1 billion, running to 2029). Medium-calibre centre of excellence shared with RWM Schweiz AG.

products: 40mm low-velocity HE and practice grenades (via Rheinmetall Waffe Munition ARGES, Austria)
product_portfolio.details: 40mm x 53 HV rounds: muzzle velocity above 240 m/s, maximum effective range 2,200 m; fit standard 40mm automatic grenade launchers; qualified for the Bundeswehr and other NATO forces.
DM45 ('Granate, Hand, DM45, 800 g'): framework contract for up to 1.5 million; first order of 962,860 to be delivered 2024-2027, produced at Silberhütte (Harz).

offering.production_capabilities: HQ and main plant at Unterlüß. Other German sites: Berlin, Düsseldorf, Oberndorf, Neuenburg am Rhein, Schneizlreuth, Trittau and Harzgerode/Silberhütte; subsidiary in Rijswijk (NL). Says it runs the largest private-sector proving grounds in Europe (Unterlüß, plus Ochsenboden, CH). New 155mm plant at Unterlüß (EUR 500 million, 50,000 m2, opened Aug 2025) has a case-manufacturing complex (forging/machining) and an LAP (filling, assembly, packaging) complex. Output was planned at 25,000 rounds in 2025, 140,000 in 2026 and 350,000/year from 2027. Rocket motor production there starts in 2026.

current_offers.description: New plant opened 2025, about 140,000 rounds planned for 2026 and full capacity of 350,000 rounds/year from 2027. Rocket motor production for artillery rockets starts in 2026.
Bundeswehr framework contract extended to about EUR 1 billion (to 2029). New call-off worth several hundred million euros for a medium six-figure number of rounds.
Framework agreement between BAAINBw and RWM for up to 1.5 million grenades. First order of 962,860 (EUR 67 million) delivered in annual instalments 2024-2027.
Bundeswehr orders for DM131 ABM rounds (about EUR 22.9 million) and about 200,000 DM158 practice rounds (about EUR 7.2 million).

offering.notes: Press releases often name only 'Rheinmetall' rather than the RWM subsidiary. The 155mm plant, Puma and 40mm orders are attributed to RWM because they are made at RWM sites (Unterlüß HQ), but not every release names the legal entity. The DM45 contract is explicitly signed with RWM. The Bundeswehr's DM51 fragmentation hand grenade is made by Diehl Defence, not Rheinmetall, so the hand grenades in TED notices are probably pyrotechnic types such as DM45. No group-level employee count specific to RWM was verified (a job portal claims 10,000+, which likely refers to the whole group). The Baltic orders source was found in search but not opened.

offered: Large-calibre: Leopard 2 120 mm gun, 155 mm artillery ammunition (Unterlüß plant ramping to 350,000 rounds a year from 2027), sensor-fuzed rounds, rocket motors

catalogue.summary: German weapons and ammunition manufacturer with 32 TED lots, mainly sole-source Bundeswehr orders: 40×53 mm grenade ammunition (DM131 airburst, DM158 practice, HE/HEDP mixed belts), 30×173 mm DM33 and DM58 for the Puma, pyrotechnic hand grenades (DM45 smoke up to 1.5M, DM149/DM159/DM169 stun, DM59 simulators), and Leopard 2 gun barrels and cradles. offering.about: Fabryka Broni 'Łucznik' - Radom is a state-owned Polish small-arms maker in Radom and part of Polska Grupa Zbrojeniowa (PGZ). It makes the MSBS GROT modular rifle family, Beryl carbines, VIS pistols, grenade launchers and submachine guns for the Polish Armed Forces, the Ministry of Interior, civilian buyers and export. The factory marked its 100th anniversary in 2025 and opened a new production hall that year.

product_portfolio.details: GROT A3: 5.56mm NATO, 700-900 rds/min, muzzle velocity 890 m/s, effective range 500 m. Modular design for conventional and bullpup layouts. Slimmer handguard, improved gas regulator, reinforced stock mount. Developed with the Military University of Technology (WAT).

products: MSBS GROT pistol (US market, 10.5/13/14.5 in barrels)
product_portfolio.details: ATF classification obtained for GROT pistol configurations for US civilian sales.
9mm.
Currently sold on the civilian market; may later go to uniformed services.

offering.production_capabilities: Integrated small-arms factory in Radom. A new 3,500 m2 production hall (over PLN 31 million) opened on 25 Nov 2025, lifting capacity to 80,000 small arms a year from 2026. Described as one of the most technologically advanced small-arms plants in Europe.
certifications: ISO 9001 (versions 2008/2001 cited in older sources)
AQAP 2110
AQAP 2105
NCAGE 0240H
markets: Export (incl. US civilian market via Arms of America LLC)

current_offers.description: Contract signed 24 June 2026 with the Polish Armament Agency for about 46,000 GROT A3 rifles (about PLN 600 million), delivered 2026-2027, with an option reported for 22,900 more. Reports also mention VIS 100 pistols and 40mm under-barrel grenade launchers in related procurement.
New production hall opened; capacity of 80,000 small arms a year from 2026.

current_offers.item: MSBS GROT pistol / Beryl - US civilian market
current_offers.description: Shown at SHOT Show 2026 (Las Vegas, 20-23 Jan 2026). ATF approval for GROT pistols with 10.5/13/14.5 in barrels; Arms of America LLC is the US distributor and more US dealers are being sought.

offering.employees: More than 500 (per Polish defence industry portal)
offering.notes: The company website (fabrykabroni.pl) could not be fetched (connection refused / certificate error), so the details come from the Polish government defence industry portal and defence press. Certification versions (ISO 9001:2008, AQAP 2110:2009) are from older catalogues and current versions were not verified. Whether the VIS 100 and grenade launcher quantities are part of the June 2026 GROT contract or a separate deal is unclear across sources.

Platforms covered: 5.56 mm MSBS GROT, Beryl/Mini-Beryl, 9 mm VIS 100 pistol, PM-84P/PM-98 submachine guns
Steady call-offs under framework 19/W/2024 with Regional Logistics Bases 1 and 2 (15 lots, about PLN 45M since 2024), always as the only bidder (it is the original manufacturer)
offered: Manufacturer of MSBS GROT C14 A3 rifles (June 2026 contract for about 46,000 rifles), Beryl, VIS 100 pistols, MPS submachine gun, 40 mm grenade launchers
Capacity of 80,000 small arms a year from 2026 after a new production hall; AQAP 2110, ISO 9001, NCAGE 0240H

catalogue.summary: Original manufacturer of Polish Army small arms that, as sole bidder under framework 19/W/2024 and standalone tenders (15 lots, about PLN 44.7M, 2024-2026), supplies spare parts, service/repair kits, inspection gauges, special tools and UTM training-ammunition conversion kits (bolt assemblies and M16/M4 magazines) for the MSBS GROT, Beryl/Mini-Beryl, VIS 100, P-83, PM-84P/PM-98 and the ceremonial carbine. It also makes the rifles themselves: the MSBS GROT C14 A3 (about 46,000 ordered in 2026), Beryl carbines, VIS 100 M1 pistols, the MPS submachine gun and 40 mm grenade launchers.

offering.about: Transcarpat Sportours International SRL is a Bucharest company, founded in 2003, that supplies firearms and ammunition to the Romanian Ministry of National Defence, Ministry of Internal Affairs bodies and other state security services. It is the main Romanian partner of Colt CZ Group: under a partnership announced in November 2024 it assembles CZ weapons in Romania, including the CZ BREN 2 rifle, Scorpion EVO3 submachine gun and CZ pistols.

product_portfolio.details: CZ BREN 2 is described as the first NATO-standard assault rifle made in Romania, via the Colt CZ Group partnership.
9x19mm. The CZ P-10C is called the best-selling pistol in Romania. Up to 6,800 9x19mm pistols contracted for the Border Police.
Supplied to the Bucharest General Police Directorate.

offering.production_capabilities: Assembles Colt CZ Group weapons in Romania (CZ BREN 2, BREN 2 PDW, Scorpion EVO3, P-07/P-09/P-10C/P-10F) under a partnership announced 22 Nov 2024. The assembly site and capacity were not published.
markets: Romania - Ministry of National Defence and special forces units
Romania - National Police, Border Police, Gendarmerie (incl. Special Intervention Brigade)
Romania - Romsilva forest rangers, local police, court security

current_offers.item: Local assembly of CZ weapons in Romania
current_offers.description: Partnership with Colt CZ Group to assemble the CZ BREN 2 / BREN 2 PDW, Scorpion EVO3 and CZ pistols in Romania for state customers.
Won a tender (about RON 10 million) for up to 6,800 9x19mm pistols, delivered over 18 months.

offering.revenue: About RON 28 million turnover with over RON 6 million profit for the previous financial year (reported Sept 2023, likely FY2022)
offering.notes: No official website found (transcarpat.ro does not resolve). All facts come from Romanian press. No source confirmed the optics product line mentioned in TED notices. Compliance and reputational caveats: in 2013 the Romanian Competition Council fined the company together with foreign firms (about EUR 2.8 million in total) for bid-rigging on 2005-2007 MoD tenders. In April 2026 its managers were indicted for keeping military automatic weapons for personal use and for illegal shooting. It is unclear whether the company is a full manufacturer or mainly an assembler/distributor of CZ products; it is classified here as manufacturer_and_distributor because of the local assembly.

proven: Small-arms ammunition across many calibres for the Romanian MoD, police and penitentiary police: 7.62×25, 7.65×17, 7.62×39, 9×19, 7.62×51 blank, 12.7×99 linked, .338 LM, 12-gauge less-lethal
Uncooled thermal surveillance equipment for the Romanian Police (about RON 5.6M) and vehicle-barrier kits
51 lots since 2024, mostly 24–48-month frameworks; wins in competitive tenders (20 lots with several bidders)
offered: Colt CZ Group's partner in Romania: local assembly of the CZ BREN 2 / BREN 2 PDW, Scorpion EVO3 and CZ P-07/P-09/P-10 pistols (partnership from November 2024)

catalogue.summary: Broad Romanian state supplier of small-arms ammunition: 9×19, 12.7×99 linked, 7.62×51 blank and precision, 7.65×17, 7.62×25, 7.62×39, .338 LM HPBT and 12-gauge less-lethal, mostly under 24-48-month frameworks with the MoD, police, penitentiary police and IGSU. It also delivers 9×19 SMGs and pistols, PROPARMS 20 mm EOD disruptor consumables, uncooled thermal imagers, vehicle-blocking kits, VAMTAC vehicle spare parts and range/training systems. It is Colt CZ Group's Romanian partner (CZ BREN 2, Scorpion EVO 3, P-10C).

contracts.buyer: Directorate General of the Prison and Court Guard Corps
contracts.title: Non-lethal weapons and accessories
contracts.description:
Used within the Prison and Court Guard Corps in accordance with § 31(1)(j) of Act No. 4/2001 Coll. on the Prison and Court Guard Corps, as amended, as a shock gas and electric stun device.
Electroshock stun device with dual-shot cartridges with contact electrodes. The stun device must have at least two cartridges, which can be fired separately, but not simultaneously. The stun device can also be used in contact (touch) mode without firing the electrodes. Each shot must be accompanied by ejected “confetti” which must contain the serial number of the fired cartridge. The stun device must ensure paralysis of the nervous system of the person hit. 
A more detailed technical specification is given in the tender documents.

catalogue.summary: Panna Plus is a Ljubljana defence integrator that supplies heavy munitions to the Slovenian MoD through OEM partners: 155 mm modular propellant charges (EUR 15.98M), M4A2/M119A2/M203 bagged 155 mm charges (13,000 units, EUR 13.0M) and MK-82 bomb kits (EUR 14.55M), plus 9×19 mm NATO ball and EOD demolition explosives. It also provides the C2 upgrade of the ship Triglav, aviation and NVLS MAXIMUS night-vision maintenance, Kärcher Futuretech equipment support, metal detectors, X-ray and IMS trace detection, and airfield/logistics equipment.

These cover 7.62×51 mm NATO belted 4:1 ball/tracer (EUR 37.1M Army framework), boxed and linked ball (EUR 10.98M), M13-linked frangible training rounds, and 5.56×45 mm and 7.62×51 mm NATO for the Guardia Civil (EUR 8.3M incl. offering.about: Accuracy International (AI) is a British manufacturer of precision bolt-action sniper, anti-materiel and competition rifles, founded by British international target shooters in Portsmouth, England, where design, development, testing and manufacturing take place; a US facility handles assembly and testing for the American market. It rose to prominence with the UK MoD L96A1 contract in 1985 and says it has supplied tactical rifles to more than 70 nations. In May 2026 FN Browning Group announced an agreement to acquire AI, which will keep operating under its own brand.
offering.parent_group: FN Browning Group (acquisition agreement announced 28 May 2026, subject to regulatory approval)

product_portfolio.details: Multi-calibre bolt-action systems with Quickloc barrel change. AX MKIII evolved from the AXMC and is tested to current NATO requirements for military sniper rifles; it is .338 Lapua Magnum as standard, convertible to .300 Win Mag or .308. AXSR was selected by the Australian Defence Force under LAND 159. Calibres across the range include .223 Rem, .308 Win, .300 Win Mag, .338 Lapua Magnum and .50 BMG.
AX 50 ELR in .50 BMG, convertible to .408 CheyTac or .375 CheyTac; Arca-Swiss tripod rail, 10-round double-stack magazines.
Civilian versions for precision rifle series and other competition and long-range sport shooting.

products: Rifle spare parts and attachments (e.g. AXMC parts supplied to Lithuania)
product_portfolio.details: The ISO 9001 scope covers procurement and repair services and training provision, as well as design and manufacture of firearms and accessories.

offering.production_capabilities: Design, development, testing and manufacturing at its Portsmouth, England headquarters. A US facility does assembly and testing for the US market. Products are subject to UK export controls (Export Control Act 2002 / Export Control Order 2008).

offering.about: Zarimex Ltd, founded in 1998 and based in Sofia, trades in firearms, hunting and gas weapons, air rifles, blank cartridges, hunting and small-arms cartridges, optics, clothing and tactical equipment. It runs a retail shop and online store as well as a wholesale business. The company says it is the official Bulgarian representative of a large number of foreign brands, supplies more than 150 Bulgarian companies, and supplies the Bulgarian Ministry of Interior, Ministry of Defence, Special Forces and other state security bodies.

product_portfolio.details: Rifle, pistol/revolver, rimfire and shotgun cartridges, gas-signal and blank ammunition, airgun pellets, plus reloading components (primers, cases, bullets, gunpowder from Nobel Sport, dies and presses from Forster and Redding).
Hunting rifles, shotguns, AR- and AK-type rifles, pistols and revolvers, modular rifle systems, barrels, bolt heads and stocks.
Gas-alarm pistols and revolvers, air rifles and pistols, airsoft, crossbows.
Suppressors, modules, muzzle brakes and adapters.
Riflescopes, red dots, thermal and clip-on sights, thermal binoculars, night vision, binoculars, rangefinders, spotting scopes, mounts (Spuhr, Ernst Apel, Rusan).

product_portfolio.details: Batons, stun guns, sprays, handcuffs and holsters.

current_offers.description: E-shop in Bulgarian, English and German, offering free ground shipping above a threshold (EUR 250 in April 2026), plus New Arrivals, Discounts, Outlet and Clearance sections, a used-weapons marketplace and TBI leasing.

offering.notes: The live site zarimex.eu (zarimex.com redirects there) blocks automated access with a Cloudflare challenge, so content was read from Wayback Machine snapshots from April 2026. The site gives the name Zarimex Ltd, Sofia, founded 1998, and names the Bulgarian Ministry of Interior and Ministry of Defence as customers, which matches the TED profile. The EIK 121535135 itself was not shown on the pages reviewed. The brand list is the company's own claim of official Bulgarian representation. The company also says it is one of the organisers of Bulgarian hunting fairs. No manufacturing capability was found.

offering.about: Rheinmetall Denel Munition (RDM) is a South African joint venture formed in 2008: Rheinmetall Waffe Munition GmbH holds 51% and the state-owned Denel holds 49%. It develops, designs and manufactures large- and medium-calibre ammunition families, including artillery, mortar, infantry (40 mm), naval ammunition, minefield breaching systems, pyrotechnics and propellants. It took over the former Denel units Somchem, Swartklip, Naschem and Boksburg, and serves mainly Asia, the Middle East, South America and Africa, with growing sales to European NATO customers.
offering.parent_group: Rheinmetall AG (via Rheinmetall Waffe Munition GmbH, 51%); Denel (Pty) Ltd 49%

offering.about: Rivolier (Manufacture Speciale d'Armes Fines et Cycles Rivolier Pere et Fils) is a family-owned group founded in 1830 and based in Saint-Just-Saint-Rambert (Loire), which became a distributor-importer in the early 1990s. It is one of France's leading distributors of hunting, sport-shooting and security/defence equipment, operating a 'Nature' division and a B2B 'Rivolier Securite-Defense' division supplying individual and collective equipment to law enforcement and armed forces. In June 2025 it acquired, with Dutch investor RSBC, the Saint-Etienne small-arms manufacturer Verney-Carron (incl. the Lebel tactical brand).

contracts.title: Voluntary ex ante transparency regarding the procurement of cooling trays for Link 16
contracts.description:
As a result of the security policy situation in the Arctic, FMI needs to acquire 20 cooling trays with associated power units for MIDS JTRS radios to support the Link 16 capability. A cooling tray is a mounting unit in which the MIDS JTRS radio is installed and which ensures cooling of the equipment during operation. MIDS JTRS is the core component of the Link 16 system, which enables the exchange of tactical data between ships, aircraft and helicopters in real time.

The situation is assessed to be an operational emergency and crucial for securing Danish sovereignty and presence in the Arctic. Functioning cooling trays with associated power units are essential for the Link 16 capability on the vessels operating in the Arctic. contracts.buyer: Danish Ministry of Defence Acquisition and Logistics Organisation
contracts.title: Acquisition of sight wings for the Danish Defence's TMG (heavy machine guns)
contracts.description:
The Danish Ministry of Defence Acquisition and Logistics Organisation (FMI) has made an urgent acquisition of sighting devices (referred to as sight wings) for use with the Danish Defence's heavy machine guns (TMG), primarily when used in field mounts (FA). The acquisition is assessed to be operationally necessary to ensure Danish sovereignty and combat power and to meet NATO's capability targets. 
The sight wings are used for mounting sights on the TMG, primarily when it is used in a field mount, and must enable the use of several sights at the same time. Two sights can thus be mounted simultaneously, side by side, on the sight wing. This is not possible directly on the weapon.

contracts.title: Acquisition of Man-Portable Remotely Operated Underwater Vehicles
contracts.description:
The Danish Ministry of Defence Acquisition and Logistics Organisation (FMI) has entered into a contract with Precision Technic Defence for the acquisition of 8 (eight) "Man Portable Remotely Operated Underwater Vehicle systems" (MP ROV), including an associated framework agreement for training, service and spare parts.
The system includes, among other things:

• ROV
• Tether
• Batteries
• Controller
• Software
• Sonar
• Camera
• Transit case
• Manipulator arm
• Disruptor

The capability shall, among other things, ensure the ability to clear harbours, inspect ship hulls, periodically monitor basins, as well as sea mine and ammunition clearance (EOD). Furthermore, the MP ROV capability shall support tasks related to “Subsurface and Seabed Warfare” and contribute to a rapid and mobile response capability for the protection of critical infrastructure.
